# Calder documentation summary

This summary is not the authoritative API contract. For current details, see
https://calder.click/docs and https://calder.click/docs/availability.

Calder is transactional email infrastructure for application-generated
messages. The API accepts a send request, persists and queues it for delivery,
and returns a message ID. HTTP 202 means queued, not delivered. A test key
simulates the pipeline without sending real email; a live key requires an
eligible sender and configured provider. Delivery events depend on provider
feedback being configured and are not a guarantee of inbox placement.

Use an idempotency key when retrying the same logical operation. Review
https://calder.click/docs/idempotency for the current behavior. Suppression
checks apply before delivery: https://calder.click/docs/suppression.

The free plan has a 5,000-email monthly allowance and outgoing messages include
a Calder footer and abuse-report link. See https://calder.click/pricing and
https://calder.click/docs/usage-billing for current limits and billing status.
Paid checkout is not available. Public SMTP is not available. Gmail OAuth code
exists but its production approval and configuration are not verified.
Marketing is in development. Official SDK package publication is not verified.
Use direct HTTP examples: https://calder.click/docs/quickstart/curl.

- Guide: https://calder.click/docs/transactional-email
- Delivery troubleshooting: https://calder.click/docs/email-delivery-troubleshooting
- API reference: https://calder.click/docs/api-reference
- Domain setup: https://calder.click/docs/domains
- Webhooks: https://calder.click/docs/webhooks
- Security: https://calder.click/security
- Support: https://calder.click/support
